_about: The World of Chaos (levels 22-30), the mad builder's realm between Mount Ravenmist and Ghenna: a house that folds back on itself, bone walkers on the Path of Bones who rise to each other's rattle, mirror shades and chaos imps in the impossible building, leeches and a blood serpent in the Lake of Blood, the pillar wardens, the Hermit of the Cabin (a sub-boss), and the Lord of Chaos in the Hall of Pillars, tearing rifts in the floor and spilling imps.

47500.name: bone walker skeleton
47500.long_desc: A bone walker clatters along the path, built from bones that never belonged together.
47500.description: Three arms, a ribcage set sideways and a skull with too many teeth: something put this together from whatever lay on the path, and it walks.

helpers.shout: The bones of the path rattle, and more of them get up!

47501.name: mirror shade
47501.long_desc: A mirror shade steps out of the glass, wearing your face.
47501.description: It looks exactly like you, except that it smiles when you do not, and its eyes are empty silver.

helpers.shout: The house shudders, and things come out of the walls!

47502.name: chaos imp
47502.long_desc: A chaos imp turns cartwheels in the air, giggling.
47502.description: A small, bright, many-coloured thing whose shape will not hold still: horns one moment, wings the next, a grin all the time.

helpers.shout: The house shudders, and things come out of the walls!

47503.name: blood leech
47503.long_desc: A blood leech the length of an arm slides out of the red water.
47503.description: Black, ringed and glistening, with a round mouth full of tiny hooked teeth. It has fed on the lake so long it is more blood than leech.

47504.name: pillar warden
47504.long_desc: A pillar warden stands beside the huge black pillar, humming the same low note.
47504.description: A tall figure of polished black stone, faceless, its hands resting on the pillar it guards. When it moves, the hum rises to a scream.

47510.name: keeper deformed gate
47510.short_desc: the Keeper of the Deformed Gate
47510.long_desc: The Keeper of the Deformed Gate leans out of the twisted archway, blocking the way.
47510.description: A long, folded creature that seems to be part of the gate itself: iron ribs, a hinged jaw, eyes like keyholes. It asks no questions; it only decides.

47511.name: librarian
47511.long_desc: The Librarian shelves a book upside down and looks at you over its spectacles.
47511.description: A thin, grey, stooping figure whose spectacles have no glass. Every book in its library is the same book, and it has read it ten thousand times.

47512.name: blood serpent
47512.long_desc: A great blood serpent rises from the lake, red water streaming from its scales.
47512.description: A sea serpent the colour of a wound, as long as a ship, with a mane of dripping tendrils. It is the Lake of Blood's oldest thing.

47520.name: hermit cabin
47520.long_desc: The Hermit of the Cabin rocks in his chair, muttering measurements.
47520.description: A wild-haired old man in a builder's apron, covered in chalk lines and plumb strings. He was the mad builder's apprentice once, and he knows every wrong angle in this place, because he drew them.

47530.name: lord chaos
47530.long_desc: The Lord of Chaos stands among the pillars, and the hall bends around him.
47530.description: A figure that is never the same twice: a king in a crown of broken compasses, a child, a storm of glass. The builder made this world for him, or he made the builder; either way, everything here answers to him.

phases.message: The Lord of Chaos laughs, and the pillars begin to scream!

abilities.name: Unmaking Wave
abilities.telegraph: The Lord of Chaos spreads his hands, and the hall starts to come apart!

abilities.name: Twisted Blade
abilities.telegraph: The Lord of Chaos draws a blade that is the wrong shape!

abilities.name: Rewrite
abilities.telegraph: The Lord of Chaos begins to rewrite the world around you!

patrols.why: a bone walker walks the Path of Bones to the Deformed Gate

bosses.why: the Lord of Chaos in the Hall of Pillars

mechanics.label: Rift of Chaos
mechanics.why: rifts torn in the floor: step out

mechanics.shout: The Lord of Chaos tears the air open, and imps tumble out!

_fill: tools/audit/densify.py: 17 more of the zone's own ordinary creatures in its empty rooms, 0.45 hostile per walkable room as the aim

47590.room_desc: A club made from a giant femur lies here.
47590.description: A huge thighbone prised out of the Path of Bones, its knob end studded with smaller teeth.

47591.room_desc: A shard of mirror lies here, showing the wrong room.
47591.description: A jagged sliver of mirror from the room of mirrors. What it shows is never quite where you are.

47592.short_desc: a vial of chaos imp ichor
47592.room_desc: A vial of shifting ichor lies here.
47592.description: A stoppered vial of imp ichor that changes colour as you watch. It tastes of nothing, and it mends.

47593.short_desc: a lamp of the dim library
47593.room_desc: A small dim lamp lies here.
47593.description: A lamp from the dimly lit library that gives just enough light to read by, and never more.

47594.room_desc: A shield of red scales lies here.
47594.description: A kite shield faced with the overlapping crimson scales of the blood serpent, slick to the touch even when dry.

47595.short_desc: a crooked crown of black iron
47595.room_desc: A crooked crown of black iron lies here.
47595.description: A crown whose points lean every way at once, as if it were forged in a dream. The Lord of Chaos wore it askew.
